patch.value: Upstream producer cursor and mutation output transport integration

Pinned SDK ExtensionCommandReadOutput exports only row_keys; it has no producer-cursor binding or singleton-mutation envelope preservation callback. Packed consumers reject the package cursor through native --output-cursor with read_output_cursor_invalid. Package --cursor, --limit and --budget are the certified fallback; no acceptance criterion is deferred. Public upstream searches for extension producer cursor, extension cursor and producer budget found no matching open implementation issue. Revisit when a producer binding is exported.
A future SDK declares producer continuation and preserves complete mutation receipts through native transport; packed npm and Bun prove it without package fallback flags.
